6.encoding: Presence: 0 absent, 1 present; field 10 required exactly when present

8.encoding: 0 inactive, 1 active; active exactly in ENABLED

9.presence: required before and after disable; binds the exact production evaluator result

state.digest: pc.control.transition-state.v1; SHA-256 over canonical typed CBOR; optional fields have explicit presence rules

transition.change: Retain the exact module, immutable release, configuration digest and full-width generation. Deactivate only the selected installed contribution after current dependency and reverse-reference fences and side-effect-free production evaluation; clear active manifest presence and configuration active state atomically. Mutation locks on the module and affected reference dependencies survive through commit. No actor permission is granted and no external runtime effect is claimed.

authority.action: exact action registry, live scoped authority fence

evidence.format: identity credential signed by the authorized checker
evidence.binding: exact immutable candidate, action, scope, expected revision and distinct checker; consumed by this operation
actual operator, session, action, candidate digest and one-time challenge consumed by this operation

authority.snapshot: retained exact precommit authority path and live epochs/validity; no session or credential secrets
authority.approval: distinct authorized checker approves the exact candidate; live decision and authority fenced and consumed in the commit
authority.stepUp: fresh actor WebAuthn step-up bound to the exact action and candidate; consumed once in the commit

events.payload: canonical four-key CommandCommitted CBOR; commandId=operationId, aggregateRef=canonical aggregate URN, actionIntentId, intentDigest=actionIntentDigest

privacy.placement: same participant and privacy domain as authoritative aggregate
privacy.read: current read authorization required; receipt is never authorization
privacy.retention: retain receipt, typed state/authority inputs, authorization evidence, public trust and operation links under control audit retention; no automatic deletion

lifecycle.idempotency: exact replay returns original operation, receipt, evidence and event IDs/bytes/sequences
lifecycle.rollback: no domain, evidence, head, event or result effects
lifecycle.restart: scoped primary operation reconciliation; preserve UNKNOWN for unresolved COMMIT
lifecycle.delivery: qualified namespace and profile required; no legacy cursor merge
lifecycle.consumer: Disabled contribution is unavailable to new consumers. Existing generation, release identity, prior receipts and evidence remain retained; consumers must revalidate the current enabled state under their authoritative fence. A disable receipt is not authority to reuse a stale enabled contribution.

requestBinding.encoding: UTF-8 domain plus NUL; each field prefixed by uint32 big-endian UTF-8 byte length; SHA-256
requestBinding.candidate: C17 updateModule five-field body; replacementDigest uses the sole module-command-contract moduleDisableReplacementDigest owner over MOD-OP-DISABLE, canonical target URN, canonical uint64 expected revision and exact manifest digest. Configuration and generation remain independently bound by the signed before/after state and production evaluator result.
